forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'IntegrationTests do not compile: two gated tests still call the deleted RoutedSession.fork'
+---
+Commit 0c54184e (^8ysk36e) deleted RoutedSession.fork and the Router fork tests, but two gated tests in the IntegrationTests package still call it, so `swift build --build-tests --package-path IntegrationTests` fails:
+- IntegrationTests.swift:427, step 5 of the end-to-end test (a fork continues the parent's conversation)
+- SessionTreeRestorationIntegrationTests.swift:280-284, driveOriginalTree (builds a live root -> forkA, forkB, forkA -> grandfork tree)
+Fix in the way of 076b5652: drop step 5 of the end-to-end test, and build the restore tree from RecordedForkFixtures (a recorded fork tree on disk), not from live forks.
+Found 2026-10-29 while running the MTP gated suite. That run moved the two files aside; it did not change them.
\ No newline at end of file
